shared_or_similar_visual_information: A sector of a circle bounded by two radii and a circular arc. On the left, use the yellow half disk to the right of diameter JL, marked 180°. On the right, use the sector labeled 2 on spinner A.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects half of the full disk as the area specified in the problem. Right image: This sector is one of the possible numerical outcomes of spinner A.
Rationales: The left sector defines a geometric area to measure. The numeral inside the right sector is an outcome of a spinner, which enters a probability calculation.
